text:
maya: quick ping — spotted a broken anchor on /handbook/integrations#k8s after the nav tidy. link lands at top of page not the k8s section. also the k8s example uses OLD_PULL_SECRET in the snippet.

ryan: thanks, can you paste the exact snippet?

maya: sure:
```yaml
env:
  - name: OLD_PULL_SECRET
    value: "{{ .Values.pullSecret }}"
```
we should rename to REDWOOD_PULL_SECRET and add a stable anchor like `integrations-k8s`

priya: i can take this. plan: update anchor slug, rename env var in the example, add a 301 redirect for old anchors, and include a tiny CI smokecheck to curl the page and assert the fragment id is present.

docs-owners: assigning owner: @platform-team (priya). please add frontmatter owner to the doc.

priya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1302 — title: "integrations(k8s): fix anchor + update pull secret example + redirect". added nginx mapping and a one-liner smoke test in docs CI.

ci-bot: docs CI queued by priya at 2025-02-11T12:05:00Z — build #4021

maya: can someone verify we won't break external shortlinks? prefer keeping the redirect for 6 months.

ryan: 6 months SGTM. i'll sync with infra for the redirect TTL. also propose adding a lint rule to catch deprecated env var names in docs (doc-lint).

priya: staging deploy done, smokecheck passed.

ci-bot: docs build passed at 2025-02-11T12:08:40Z — smokecheck OK (fragment present, example updated)

maya: checked staging: anchor jumps correctly and snippet shows REDWOOD_PULL_SECRET. leaving LGTM on the PR.

ryan: LGTM and infra ticket opened for redirect TTL (INFRA-601). merging after changelog entry.

docs-owners: thanks all — adding follow-up task to add the doc-lint rule to next sprint.

priya: will file the lint task and add a short migration note for customers who may still use OLD_PULL_SECRET.

maya: perfect, thanks :rocket:
